biography: Timo Bernhard, a name synonymous with audacious speed and unwavering self-belief, hails from the small German town of Bruchmühlbach-Miesau. Unlike many racers born into motorsport dynasties, Timo’s path began with a battered go-kart salvaged from a scrapyard by his father, a mechanic with a passion for tinkering. That kart, christened 'Blitz' (Lightning), became Timo's crucible, where he honed his raw talent on makeshift tracks carved out of abandoned industrial estates. His defining moment came at the age of 16 during a regional karting championship. Down on power and starting from the back, Timo unleashed a series of daring overtakes, culminating in a last-corner maneuver that secured him the victory. This audacious move caught the eye of a Porsche talent scout, launching him into the world of professional racing. Now in his peak years, Timo remains a Porsche stalwart, chasing victory with the same fiery passion that ignited his career on the 'Blitz'. He currently balances his commitments to Porsche with occasional forays into sim racing, where he maintains a highly visible presence and sizable following.
drivingStyle: Timo's driving style is a reflection of his personality: aggressive, flamboyant, and bordering on reckless. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers, often carrying more speed into corners than seemingly possible. While this approach sometimes leads to spectacular results, it also carries considerable risk, pushing his tires and car to their absolute limits. He thrives under pressure, viewing it as an opportunity to showcase his talent, and isn't afraid to engage in wheel-to-wheel combat. Tire management, while improving, remains an area of focus, as his aggressive style can lead to early degradation.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during a crucial race. Enzo accused Timo of intentionally wrecking him, fueling a bitter feud both on and off the track.
Anya's calculated and precise driving style is the antithesis of Timo's, leading to frequent clashes in strategy and on-track battles for position.
Dubois, a veteran driver known for his defensive tactics, often frustrates Timo's aggressive overtaking attempts, leading to heated exchanges and near misses.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of racing socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track, 'Iron Will', exactly three times before every race.
Insists on personally polishing his helmet visor before each session, believing it improves his visibility.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, period.
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2020 after battling through treacherous conditions and mechanical setbacks, cementing his legacy as one of Porsche's greatest endurance drivers.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the 2018 Daytona 24 Hours due to a momentary lapse in concentration, costing his team a certain victory and leaving him devastated.
